steps.text: Coat one side of a piece of aluminum foil large enough to hold all the potatoes and vegetables with cooking spray. Place the potatoes, onion, and green bell pepper in the center of the foil, and season with salt and pepper to taste. Then place small pats of the butter or margarine over the vegetables.
Carefully seal all the edges of the foil around the vegetables to form a packet. (Note: Double wrapping will help to prevent burning.)
Place packet on the preheated grill, and grill for 20 minutes. Turn packet, and grill for 10 more minutes.
Carefully open packet, check for tenderness with a fork. If tender, sprinkle the cheese over the vegetables and allow it to melt. Transfer to a platter, and serve with your main entree.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Cheesy Potatoes
raw_recipe.description: Sliced potatoes, green peppers, onions, and a dab of butter are sealed in aluminum foil and tossed onto the grill. When the veggies are piping hot and tender, sprinkle with Cheddar cheese and serve.

review.reviewBody: Great combo of flavors... very easy and quick. I baked in my oven instead of the grill for about the same amount of time. Yum!

great base for lots of variations, from what veggies you add to what else goes on the grill. I don't have perfect BBQ weather so I baked thin potato slices and the veggies in the oven in a closed casserole dish for about 30 min at 350, sprinkled asiago cheese on it and let it sit in the turned off oven for 5 more min to let it melt. Very tasty!

Awesome recipe!! I made them in the oven, and not the grill. Next time I make this recipe, I will half cook the potatoes in the microwave, or boil the potatoes... THEN put them in the oven, and add cheese after they've been cooked. Very yummy outcome!! :)

These are awesome! Sliced thin, added fresh minced garlic, used "Mama Mia's Garlic Spread" (you should really try this stuff) for the butter called for and these turned out delicious! Will for sure make this again! Didn't follow the cook time. I sliced them thin, but listened to them on the grill and they turned out great. Really good.

These were pretty good..should have maybe used a sharp cheese becasue it wasn't very cheesy with the marble and I put lots on because we love cheese. And 2 layers of regulare foil is not enough...total blackness on the bottom..and hard!! Maybe some heavy duty stuff...or 4 layers of the other stuff to stopp the burning. Or this could be done in the oven and be just as tasty without the burnt.

These potatoes are great whether you cook them in tin foil on the grill or in a dish in the oven. Sometimes I don't even top them with cheese and they are still wonderful. I also add garlic and onion powder to the recipe.

Great recipe! I cut the recipe down by a third since the full recipe would certainly feed a crowd. I used Yukon Gold potatoes sliced thin, and put all the ingredients (minus the butter) in the microwave for 5 minutes prior to cooking on the grill to guarantee that everything would be cooked through. Delicious.

I used an oven with the foil packet sitting in a metal baking pan. 20 minutes on one side then 10 minutes on the other at 375 deg F. Potatoes still were not done. It took another 18 minutes in the microwave to get them perfect. My 81 year old mother said next time put them in the oven at 350 degrees F for one hour, then add the cheese for five minutes, stir and serve.

Very tasty! I only had red peppers on hand and the flavor was wonderful. I baked these in the oven at 350 degrees following the recommended cooking times. I sprinkled about 2 tsp of water on the potatoes before sealing the foil to help them steam.

HOLY COW! These are delicious! My new favorite grilling recipe! I basically made this recipe as stated but inadvertantly some slight things made it better! I had some seasoned onions from precooking my chicken for the grill, used them.(Chipotle pepper and garlic flavored)I also used bacon grease to lube the foil instead of spray and I think that added flavor too! Try this, really easy and NO CLEAN-UP!
I have made this a couple of times. I added garlic and used poblano pepper. I also baked them in the oven. They turned out very well.
followed the recipe exactly. family loved it. will definitely make again
These just weren't a hit at my house.
YUM! I have been making these for several years and always get rave rewiews. Love them on the grill....toss them on and forget about them!
i loved it it was so easy to prepare and the taste was great ")))
Sooo good!
we added ham chunks and my husband loved it - he said it reminded him of skillet breakfasts from his favorite restaurant. :)
These were so good! I add some seasoning salt and have tried them with a few slices of bacon added and with some left over chicken and both were wonderful.
These really good! I baked them in the oven instead, my family loved them!! Thanks for the great recipe!!!
I baked these in the oven, since we didn't have the grill going, but they were still great! Thanks for the recipe!
